summary: The Google Ads REST version baked into every path, schema name, spec version and User-Agent is a moving target: it must be a currently supported version, and a reprint must re-source the spec from the live discovery doc rather than keep the printed one.
reason: Google retires each Ads API version on a fixed sunset schedule and then rejects it with requestError UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, so a CLI printed against a retired version fails every call. v22 now returns that error, so this patch retargets the printed v22 surface to v26 (newest live version) as a mechanical whole-word rewrite.
validated_outcome: Against the live API: listAccessibleCustomers, GAQL googleAds:search on a manager and a client account, and MCP execute(customers_google_ads.search) all succeed on v26 where the same calls on v22 return HTTP 400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. Diffing the v22 and v26 discovery docs, only configureCampaignLifecycleGoals and configureCustomerLifecycleGoals are gone, so those two commands fail on v26.
